mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy within the next 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with increased corporate earnings within the next 2 quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates strong demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of periods with sustained HOUST increases, or HOUST growth does not correlate with broader economic growth indicators within the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decline does not correlate with reduced corporate earnings within the next month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing YoY, the combined signal indicates a tightening monetary policy cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high FEDFUNDS and rising CPI does not lead to tighter monetary policy within the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over a 3-month period, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4%, signals strong labor market conditions and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the combined labor market indicators do not correlate with economic growth within the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over a 6-month period indicates strong consumer demand, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of periods with sustained RSAFS increases, or RSAFS growth does not correlate with broader economic growth indicators within the next 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is declining and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, the combined signal indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of declining INDPRO and rising UNRATE does not correlate with a weakening economy within the next quarter.
